title: Bank support orchestrator agent
subtitle: A runnable Orchestrator Agent
description: One orchestrator agent that delegates to three specialist agents - loan, account, and card support - each running as its own process with a real tool call. The orchestrator decides which specialist(s) to invoke, combines their answers, and resolves automatically or hands off to a human.
creator: Camunda

variables.customerRequest: I'm refinancing my $240,000 mortgage at 6.5% interest over 30 years - what would my new monthly payment be?
